description: Resolve a one-time trusted-device pairing after the browser has enrolled. Requires the original pairing ID and pairing code and is available only until that pairing capability expires.

pairing_code.description: One-time pairing code issued together with the pairing_id; required with it and valid only until the pairing capability expires.

pairing_id.description: Pairing identifier (UUID) returned by ghostkey_device_pairing_create for the one-time enrollment capability to resolve.

name: ghostkey_device_pairing_status
title: GhostKey Device Pairing Status
